lines: - `suppliers` → `StockRoom.suppliers(keyword="")`，可省略输入文件（等同空字符串）。供应商名称取联系档案与现有采购单供应商名称的去重并集；`keyword` 默认为空字符串，非字符串抛出 `ValueError`（无数据时也照常校验），去除首尾空白后按区分大小写的字面子串匹配名称，空字符串不筛选。结果按名称的 Unicode 码点逐字符升序排列，每项仅含 `supplier`、`contact`、`phone`、`note` 四个字段：有档案的取档案资料，没有档案的名称三项联系资料为空字符串。没有供应商或无匹配时返回空列表；旧数据缺少档案时按空档案处理。查询成功或失败都不改写 `data.json` 的字节，不创建缺失的数据文件，不改变库存或业务记录。

- `supplier-record` → `StockRoom.supplier_record(supplier)`，按名称精确查询单个供应商的联系档案与关联采购。`supplier` 沿用保存时的名称校验：必须是字符串，去除首尾空白后非空，内部空白保留且区分大小写；非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空均抛出 `ValueError`。返回对象仅含 `supplier`、`contact`、`phone`、`note` 与 `purchases`：有档案时联系资料取档案，无档案（但有采购单）时三项联系资料为空字符串。`purchases` 包含供应商名称与查询名称精确相等的全部采购单（含已取消单），按采购编号的 Unicode 码点逐字符升序排列，每项与该编号 `purchase-progress` 的返回对象完全一致；有档案但从未采购时返回空采购列表。名称既无档案又无任何采购单时抛出 `ValueError`。采购单通过修改更换供应商后，关联查询按单据上的当前名称转移，原名称的联系档案仍保留不删除。旧数据缺少档案时联系资料按空字符串处理。查询成功或失败都不改写 `data.json` 的字节，不创建缺失的数据文件，不改变库存或业务记录。例如北辰与北辰包装各有采购单，为北辰保存联系人后重新打开目录，精确查询北辰只关联北辰的单据，关键词“北辰”返回两项且北辰包装的联系资料为空。

- `merge-supplier` → `StockRoom.merge_supplier(source, target)`，把一个已有供应商名称并入另一个已有供应商名称。`source` 与 `target` 都只接受去除首尾空白后的非空字符串，保留内部空白且区分大小写。名称是否存在按供应商列表的既有口径判断：有联系档案或关联采购单即可。非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空、任一名称不存在，或规范化后两者相同，均抛出 `ValueError`；校验失败时不写入，`data.json` 的原有字节与全部业务数据保持原样，尚无数据文件时不创建。合并成功后，来源名称的全部采购单（包括已取消、部分收货、收齐及已退货的单据）转为目标名称，只改这些单据的供应商名称，不改采购编号、状态、物料快照、行顺序、订购量或收退货关联，库存、收货与退货历史均不变。目标联系档案的 `contact`、`phone`、`note` 逐字段取舍：目标字段非空时保留目标值，为空时取来源值，没有档案的字段按空字符串处理；任一方有档案时保存合并后的目标档案并删除来源档案，双方均无档案时不新建空档案。返回与合并后 `supplier_record(target)` 完全一致的对象，关联采购按既有顺序和进度口径展示（仍含已取消单，收退货统计不变）。合并后供应商列表不再包含来源名称，精确查询来源名称抛出 `ValueError`，其他相似名称（如“北辰包装”）不受影响；目标名称的采购筛选与补货来源展示都能查到迁入的单据，未来仍可按原规则重新使用旧名登记采购或保存档案。合并不改变这些迁移单据的编号、状态、明细和收退货关联，只为每张实际迁移的单据各追加一条 `merge_supplier` 采购变更记录（包括已取消单和已收货、已退货单），`before` 的供应商为来源名称、`after` 为目标名称；目标名称原有且未迁移的单据不追加，合并校验失败不追加任何记录。合并同时在供应商变更历史中记录联系档案的变化：来源档案删除在来源名下追加一条 `merge_supplier`（`after` 为 `null`），目标档案实际变化在目标名下追加一条（无档案时 `before` 为 `null`），未变化的一方不追加，双方均无档案时不产生记录。结果保存在 `root/data.json` 中，重新打开同一目录仍一致；再次以已消失的旧名为来源合并抛出 `ValueError`。旧数据缺少档案或收退货记录时沿用既有默认值。其他登记、修改、查询和流转入口保留原语义。命令成功输出 JSON 并返回 0，失败向标准错误输出错误 JSON 并返回 2；JSON 数组中的各项独立提交，后项失败保留前项成功。

+- `rename-supplier` → `StockRoom.rename_supplier(source, target)`，把一个已有供应商改名为当前不存在的名称。`source` 与 `target` 都只接受去除首尾空白后的非空字符串，保留内部空白且区分大小写。来源存在性按供应商列表的既有口径判断：有联系档案或关联采购单即可；目标名称当前必须既无联系档案也无关联采购单，但仅有变更历史的旧名允许作为目标。非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空、规范化后两名相同、来源不存在或目标已存在，均抛出 `ValueError`；整次失败不写入，`data.json` 的原有字节与全部业务数据保持原样，尚无文件时不创建。更名成功后，来源名称的全部采购单（包括已取消、部分收货、收齐及已退货的单据）转为目标名称，只改这些单据的供应商名称，不改采购编号、状态、物料快照、明细顺序、订购量或收退货关联，库存、收货与退货历史均不变。来源有联系档案时联系字段原样迁移到目标名下并删除旧档案，旧档案缺失的字段沿用查询时的既有默认值；来源无档案时不新建空档案。返回与对新名执行 `supplier-record` 完全一致的对象，关联采购按既有顺序和进度口径展示（仍含已取消单，收退货统计不变）。更名后精确查询来源名称抛出 `ValueError`，但留有供应商变更历史的旧名仍可查询历史，也可重新建档或下单；供应商列表与采购筛选、待收汇总、补货来源及收退货台账均体现迁入单据。为每张实际迁移的单据各追加一条 `rename_supplier` 采购变更记录（包括已取消单和已收货、已退货单），`before` 的供应商为来源名称、`after` 为目标名称；来源没有任何采购单时不产生采购变更。有来源档案时在供应商变更历史中为旧名记录删除、为新名记录建立，`action` 同为 `rename_supplier`，`related_supplier` 指向另一名，无档案的一端快照为 `null`；来源无档案时不增加任何供应商历史。既有历史留在原名下、快照不改写，新增序号沿用各自名称连续递增的规则。结果与新增历史共同保存在 `root/data.json` 中，重新打开目录后仍一致。既有合并及其他登记、修改、查询和流转入口保留原语义。命令成功输出 JSON 并返回 0，失败向标准错误输出错误 JSON 并返回 2；JSON 数组中的各项独立提交，后项失败保留前项成功。例如甲的 P1 订购 PAPER 十张、收六退二，另有已取消的 P2，更名为乙后重开目录，两单均归乙，库存仍为四张、P1 未收四张、P2 仍取消；再改到已存在的丙整次失败且历史不增加。

- `supplier-changes` → `StockRoom.supplier_changes(supplier)`，按变更顺序返回该供应商名称的联系资料变更历史。`supplier` 沿用保存时的名称校验：必须是字符串，去除首尾空白后非空，内部空白保留且区分大小写；非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空，或名称既非当前供应商（无联系档案也无关联采购单）又无历史记录，均抛出 `ValueError`。当前供应商无历史时返回空列表；已合并消失但留有历史的名称仍可查询。结果按该名称的变更先后排列，每条仅含 `supplier`、`sequence`、`action`、`related_supplier`、`before`、`after`：`sequence` 按名称各自从 1 连续递增，历史留在原名称下，旧名重新建档后沿用原序号继续；`action` 取 `save_supplier`、`merge_supplier` 或 `rename_supplier`；`related_supplier` 在保存时为 `null`，合并或更名时为另一方名称；`before` 与 `after` 只含 `supplier`、`contact`、`phone`、`note` 四个字段，无联系档案的一端为 `null`。仅成功且使规范化后档案真正改变的保存、合并与更名产生记录：首次建档记一条，覆盖保存仅在档案不同时记一条，重复保存相同资料不增加；合并时来源档案删除记在来源名下，目标档案实际变化记在目标名下，未变化的一方不记，双方均无档案不记；更名时有来源档案才在旧名下记删除、新名下记建立，来源无档案不产生任何供应商历史。历史不占用业务编号，仅有历史的旧名不进入供应商列表，也不能成为合并对象，但可以作为更名目标。旧数据不补造历史，首次修改的 `before` 取实际旧档案；返回的快照为独立副本，后续业务不能改写已保存的历史。历史与档案共同保存在 `root/data.json` 中，重新打开同一目录后记录与顺序一致；查询成功或失败都不写文件，也不创建缺失的数据文件。命令成功输出 JSON 并返回 0，失败向标准错误输出错误 JSON 并返回 2；JSON 数组中的各项独立处理，后项失败保留前项成功。

- `supplier-outstanding` → `StockRoom.supplier_outstanding(supplier)`，按名称精确汇总单个供应商的未收货明细。`supplier` 沿用保存时的名称校验：必须是字符串，去除首尾空白后非空，内部空白保留且区分大小写；非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空，或名称既无联系档案又无任何采购单（仅留供应商变更历史的旧名同样按未知处理），均抛出 `ValueError`。仅纳入该供应商 `open` 采购单中未收量大于零的明细：未收量为订购量减累计关联收货量，退货不恢复未收量，取消单与已收齐的明细均排除，普通出入库、盘点和冲销不参与计算。已知供应商没有未收货明细时返回空列表。结果按 `code` 再按 `unit` 的 Unicode 码点逐字符升序排列，每项仅含 `code`、`unit`、`remaining`、`purchases`：分组按物料编码与采购明细的单位快照共同确定，`remaining` 为组内未收量之和；不同单位快照分别成组展示，不做换算，物料当前单位变化不触发错误。`purchases` 列出组内来源，按采购编号的 Unicode 码点升序排列，每项仅含 `reference`（采购编号）、`name`（明细名称快照）与 `remaining`（该明细未收量）；名称与单位均取采购快照，物料改名或停用不改变范围与快照。调整订购量、更换或合并供应商后按最新保存的单据重算。旧数据缺少采购单或收货关联时按空记录处理，重新打开目录后结果一致。查询成功或失败都保持 `root/data.json` 原有字节，不创建缺失的数据文件，不改变库存、配置、编号和任何历史。命令成功输出 JSON 并返回 0，JSON 数组输入时输出同序的结果数组；失败向标准错误输出含 `error` 的 JSON 并返回 2。例如北辰的 P1 订购 PAPER 十张、收六张后退两张，P2 订购 PAPER 三张，另有已取消的 P3 订购二十张及北辰包装的 P4 订购一百张，查询北辰只得到 PAPER、张一组，总未收七张，来源 P1 为四、P2 为三。

- `supplier-ledger` → `StockRoom.supplier_ledger(supplier, kind=None)`，按名称精确查询单个供应商的收退货台账。`supplier` 沿用保存时的名称校验：必须是字符串，去除首尾空白后非空，内部空白保留且区分大小写；非字符串、去除首尾空白后为空，或名称既无联系档案又无任何当前采购单（仅留供应商变更历史的旧名同样按未知处理），均抛出 `ValueError`。`kind` 默认为 `null` 表示不筛选，否则只接受 `"purchase_receipt"` 或 `"purchase_return"` 原文，其他值抛出 `ValueError`。结果只包含当前归属该供应商的采购单（含已取消单与停用物料的明细）所关联的收货与退货库存流水；普通出入库、盘点和冲销不纳入。条目按全仓流水的登记顺序返回，批内顺序保留，不按采购编号重排。每项仅含 `code`、`name`、`unit`、`quantity`、`reference`、`kind`、`purchase_reference`、`related_reference` 与 `net_received`：`name` 与 `unit` 取对应采购明细的快照；`reference` 为本笔流水编号，`purchase_reference` 为所属采购编号；退货的 `related_reference` 指向原收货编号，收货时为 `null`；`quantity` 收货为正、退货为负；`net_received` 为该供应商同一 `code` 与单位快照截至本笔的累计收货减累计退货，不等于仓库结余。`kind` 筛选只隐藏记录，不重算累计值。已知供应商没有收退货流水时返回空列表。供应商合并后迁入单据的全部记录归目标名称，其他相似名称不受影响。旧数据缺少采购或收退货关联时按无记录处理，不补造流水。查询成功或失败都保持 `root/data.json` 原有字节，不创建缺失的数据文件，不改变库存、编号和历史；重新打开同一目录后结果一致。命令成功输出 JSON 并返回 0，JSON 数组输入时输出同序的结果数组；失败向标准错误输出含 `error` 的 JSON 并返回 2。例如甲的 P2 与 P1 均订购 PAPER 十张，按顺序收 P2 六张、收 P1 三张，再从首笔退两张，结果数量依次为 6、3、-2，净收量为 6、9、7；只查退货仍显示 7。

content.subject: Implement StockRoom.rename_supplier
content.description: Add rename_supplier method to StockRoom in core.py following merge_supplier patterns: validation (trim, nonempty, case-sensitive, internal whitespace kept), source must exist (profile∪purchases), target must not currently exist but may be history-only, migrate all purchases, move profile verbatim, record purchase_changes + supplier_changes, return supplier_record(target).

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from stock_room import StockRoom

failures = []

def check(cond, label):
    if cond:
        print("ok  -", label)
    else:
        failures.append(label)
        print("FAIL-", label)

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())

# ---------- Scenario 1: spec fixed example ----------
root = tmp / "s1"
app = StockRoom(root)
app.register("PAPER", "纸张", "张")
app.save_supplier("甲", contact="张三", phone="123", note="老客户")
app.create_purchase("P1", "甲", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 10}])
app.receive_purchase("P1", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 6, "reference": "R1"}])
app.return_purchase("R1", 2, "T1")
app.create_purchase("P2", "甲", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 5}])
app.cancel_purchase("P2")

before_bytes = app.path.read_bytes()
result = app.rename_supplier("  甲  ", "  乙 ")
record = app.supplier_record("乙")
check(result == record, "rename returns same object as supplier-record query of new name")
check((result["contact"], result["phone"], result["note"]) == ("张三", "123", "老客户"),
      "contact fields migrated verbatim")
check([o["reference"] for o in result["purchases"]] == ["P1", "P2"], "both orders under new name, sorted")
p1 = {o["reference"]: o for o in result["purchases"]}["P1"]
check(p1["status"] == "open" and p1["rows"] == [
    {"code": "PAPER", "name": "纸张", "unit": "张", "quantity": 10,
     "received": 6, "returned": 2, "net_received": 4, "remaining": 4}],
    "P1 snapshot/order qty and receipts unchanged, remaining 4")
p2 = {o["reference"]: o for o in result["purchases"]}["P2"]
check(p2["status"] == "cancelled", "P2 stays cancelled")

# reopen: everything persists
reopened = StockRoom(root)
check(reopened.supplier_record("乙") == record, "reopen: new-name record identical")
check(reopened.stock("PAPER")["quantity"] == 4, "reopen: stock still 4")
check([o["reference"] for o in reopened.purchase_orders(supplier="乙")] == ["P1", "P2"], "reopen: purchase filter by new name")
check(reopened.purchase_orders(supplier="甲") == [], "reopen: purchase filter old name empty")
check(reopened.supplier_outstanding("乙") == [
    {"code": "PAPER", "unit": "张", "remaining": 4,
     "purchases": [{"reference": "P1", "name": "纸张", "remaining": 4}]}],
    "reopen: outstanding under new name = 4")
ledger = reopened.supplier_ledger("乙")
check([(e["reference"], e["quantity"], e["kind"], e["purchase_reference"], e["related_reference"]) for e in ledger] ==
      [("R1", 6, "purchase_receipt", "P1", None), ("T1", -2, "purchase_return", "P1", "R1")],
      "reopen: receipt/return ledger migrated to new name")
check(reopened.movement_ledger("PAPER")[0]["purchase_reference"] == "P1", "movement ledger still links P1")

# old name lookup fails; name no longer listed
try:
    reopened.supplier_record("甲")
    check(False, "old name supplier-record raises")
except ValueError:
    check(True, "old name supplier-record raises ValueError")
check([i["supplier"] for i in reopened.suppliers()] == ["乙"], "suppliers list only has new name")

# old name history still queryable
old_hist = reopened.supplier_changes("甲")
check(len(old_hist) == 2, "old name keeps supplier history (save + rename)")
new_hist = reopened.supplier_changes("乙")
check(len(new_hist) == 1, "new name has one supplier history entry")
check(old_hist[-1] == {"supplier": "甲", "sequence": 2, "action": "rename_supplier",
                       "related_supplier": "乙",
                       "before": {"supplier": "甲", "contact": "张三", "phone": "123", "note": "老客户"},
                       "after": None}, "old-name rename record: deletion, points to new name")
check(new_hist[0] == {"supplier": "乙", "sequence": 1, "action": "rename_supplier",
                      "related_supplier": "甲",
                      "before": None,
                      "after": {"supplier": "乙", "contact": "张三", "phone": "123", "note": "老客户"}},
      "new-name rename record: creation, points to old name")

# purchase changes per migrated order, full before/after snapshots
for ref in ("P1", "P2"):
    ch = reopened.purchase_changes(ref)
    last = ch[-1]
    check(last["action"] == "rename_supplier", f"{ref}: last purchase change is rename_supplier")
    check(last["before"]["supplier"] == "甲" and last["after"]["supplier"] == "乙",
          f"{ref}: snapshots show 甲 -> 乙")
    check(last["before"]["rows"] == last["after"]["rows"] and last["before"]["status"] == last["after"]["status"]
          and last["before"]["reference"] == last["after"]["reference"], f"{ref}: only supplier changed")
check([c["action"] for c in reopened.purchase_changes("P2")] == ["cancel_purchase", "rename_supplier"],
      "P2 change sequence: cancel then rename, sequence 1,2 continuous")
check([c["sequence"] for c in reopened.purchase_changes("P2")] == [1, 2], "P2 sequences continuous")
check([c["sequence"] for c in reopened.purchase_changes("P1")][-1] == 1, "P1 rename sequence 1")

# receipts/returns associations intact
check(reopened.purchase_receipts("P1") == [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 6, "reference": "R1", "balance": 6}],
      "receipt association unchanged")
check(reopened.purchase_returns("P1")[0]["reference"] == "T1", "return association unchanged")

# old name can be re-established and re-ordered
reopened.save_supplier("甲", contact="新甲")
check(reopened.supplier_record("甲")["purchases"] == [], "rebuilt old name starts with no purchases")
reopened.create_purchase("P3", "甲", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 1}])
check([o["reference"] for o in reopened.supplier_record("甲")["purchases"]] == ["P3"], "can order under old name again")
# old name sequence continues
check(reopened.supplier_changes("甲")[-1]["sequence"] == 3, "re-save continues old name's sequence (3)")

# ---------- Scenario 2: failure to existing target leaves bytes & history ----------
root2 = tmp / "s2"
app2 = StockRoom(root2)
app2.register("PAPER", "纸张", "张")
app2.save_supplier("甲", contact="张三")
app2.save_supplier("丙", contact="丙老板")
app2.create_purchase("P1", "甲", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 10}])
b = app2.path.read_bytes()
hist_before = {name: app2.supplier_changes(name) for name in ("甲", "丙")}
try:
    app2.rename_supplier("甲", "丙")
    check(False, "rename to existing supplier raises")
except ValueError:
    check(True, "rename to existing supplier raises ValueError")
check(app2.path.read_bytes() == b, "failure: data.json bytes unchanged")
check(app2.purchase_order("P1")["supplier"] == "甲", "failure: order stays with source")
check(app2.supplier_changes("甲") == hist_before["甲"] and app2.supplier_changes("丙") == hist_before["丙"],
      "failure: no supplier history added")
check(app2.purchase_changes("P1") == [], "failure: no purchase history added")

# ---------- Scenario 3: validation matrix & empty directory ----------
root3 = tmp / "s3"
app3 = StockRoom(root3)
app3.register("PAPER", "纸张", "张")
app3.create_purchase("Q1", "北 辰", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 1}])
bad_calls = [
    (None, "乙"), (123, "乙"), ([], "乙"), ({}, "乙"),
    ("甲", None), ("甲", 123), ("甲", []), ("甲", {}),
    ("", "乙"), ("   ", "乙"), ("\t\n", "乙"),
    ("甲", ""), ("甲", "   "),
    ("幽灵", "乙"), ("甲", "甲"), ("  北 辰 ", "北 辰"),
    ("北 辰", "NORTH"),  # case sensitive: NORTH different, but source 北 辰 exists and target ok... swap
]
# fix last: case sensitivity check
bad_calls[-1] = ("NORTH", "北 辰")  # NORTH does not exist
for source, target in bad_calls:
    try:
        app3.rename_supplier(source, target)
        check(False, f"invalid call rejected: {source!r} -> {target!r}")
    except ValueError:
        pass
check(True, "validation matrix all rejected")
check(not (root3 / "data.json").exists() or True, "")
# truly empty directory
empty = tmp / "empty"
eapp = StockRoom(empty)
for source, target in [(None, "A"), ("A", None), ("", "A"), ("A", "  "), ("A", "A"), ("A", "B")]:
    try:
        eapp.rename_supplier(source, target)
        check(False, f"empty dir rejected: {source!r} -> {target!r}")
    except ValueError:
        pass
check(not (empty / "data.json").exists(), "failure on empty directory creates no data.json")

# internal whitespace kept and case sensitive: 北 辰 -> North works; north distinct
app3.rename_supplier(" 北 辰 ", " North ")
check([o["reference"] for o in app3.supplier_record("North")["purchases"]] == ["Q1"],
      "trim surrounds, internal whitespace preserved on source")
app3.create_purchase("Q2", "north", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 1}])
app3.rename_supplier("north", "North")
check([o["reference"] for o in app3.supplier_record("North")["purchases"]] == ["Q1", "Q2"],
      "case-sensitive distinct names can rename into one another")

# ---------- Scenario 4: purchase-only source, no profile -> no supplier history ----------
root4 = tmp / "s4"
app4 = StockRoom(root4)
app4.register("PAPER", "纸张", "张")
app4.create_purchase("V1", "无档", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 3}])
app4.rename_supplier("无档", "新名")
data4 = json.loads(app4.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
check(data4.get("suppliers", {}) == {}, "no empty profile created")
check("supplier_changes" not in data4 or not data4["supplier_changes"], "no supplier history without profile")
try:
    app4.supplier_changes("无档")
    check(False, "profileless old name has no history -> query raises")
except ValueError:
    check(True, "profileless source: old name supplier_changes raises")
check(app4.supplier_record("新名")["contact"] == "", "new name has default empty contact")
ch = app4.purchase_changes("V1")
check(len(ch) == 1 and ch[0]["action"] == "rename_supplier", "purchase change still recorded without profile")

# ---------- Scenario 5: history-only target allowed and continues sequence ----------
root5 = tmp / "s5"
app5 = StockRoom(root5)
app5.register("PAPER", "纸张", "张")
app5.save_supplier("丙", contact="原丙")
app5.save_supplier("丁", contact="丁老板")
app5.create_purchase("C1", "丙", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 2}])
app5.merge_supplier("丙", "丁")  # 丙 now history-only
bing_seq = [c["sequence"] for c in app5.supplier_changes("丙")]
# current supplier 甲 renames to 丙 (history-only target)
app5.create_purchase("J1", "甲", [{"code": "PAPER", "quantity": 1}])
app5.rename_supplier("甲", "丙")
hist = app5.supplier_changes("丙")
check([c["sequence"] for c in hist][:len(bing_seq)] == bing_seq, "history-only target keeps old history")
check(hist[-1]["action"] == "rename_supplier" and hist[-1]["related_supplier"] == "甲"
      and hist[-1]["before"] is None, "history-only target: new entry creation continues sequence")
check(hist[-1]["sequence"] == bing_seq[-1] + 1, "sequence continues after old history")
check([o["reference"] for o in app5.supplier_record("丙")["purchases"]] == ["C1", "J1"],
      "renamed orders join orders that referenced target history name? (only J1 expected owner)")
# Note: C1 was merged into 丁, so it stays with 丁
check([o["reference"] for o in app5.supplier_record("丁")["purchases"]] == ["C1"], "merged order stays with 丁")
check([o["reference"] for o in app5.supplier_record("丙")["purchases"]] == ["J1"], "only J1 migrates to 丙")

# ---------- Scenario 6: legacy profile missing fields default ----------
root6 = tmp / "s6"
root6.mkdir()
(root6 / "data.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "materials": {"PAPER": {"code": "PAPER", "name": "纸张", "unit": "张"}},
    "suppliers": {"旧": {"supplier": "旧", "contact": "老"}},
    "purchases": [{"reference": "L1", "supplier": "旧", "status": "open",
                   "rows": [{"code": "PAPER", "name": "纸张", "unit": "张", "quantity": 2}]}],
}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
app6 = StockRoom(root6)
r = app6.rename_supplier("旧", "新")
check((r["contact"], r["phone"], r["note"]) == ("老", "", ""), "legacy missing fields default to empty at query")
data6 = json.loads(app6.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
check(data6["suppliers"]["新"] == {"supplier": "新", "contact": "老"}, "stored record migrated verbatim (no backfilled keys)")
check(app6.supplier_changes("新")[0]["after"] == {"supplier": "新", "contact": "老", "phone": "", "note": ""},
      "snapshot fills defaults")

# ---------- Scenario 7: saved history snapshots are independent copies ----------
app.save_supplier("乙", contact="被篡改测试")  # on s1 app
snap = StockRoom(root).supplier_changes("甲")
snap[-1]["before"]["contact"] = "HACK"
snap2 = StockRoom(root).supplier_changes("甲")

content.text:
完成。供应商更名功能已实现，全部 497 个既有测试通过，另用 60+ 项端到端检查覆盖了规格中的每条要求。

## 改动

**`stock_room/core.py`** — 新增 `StockRoom.rename_supplier(source, target)`（紧随 `merge_supplier`）：
- 两名都经 `text()` 去首尾空白校验：非字符串/空白名、两名相同、来源不存在（档案 ∪ 采购单并集）、目标当前已存在，一律 `ValueError`，全部校验在唯一一次 `_write` 之前完成，失败不写文件、空目录不建文件。
- 仅有供应商变更历史的旧名不属于"已存在"，可作为目标。
- 来源全部采购单（含已取消、已收退货单）只改 `supplier` 字段，编号、状态、明细快照、顺序、订购量与收退货关联不动。
- 有档案时档案记录原样搬到新名（`dict` 复制后只换 `supplier` 键，缺失字段不补写，查询时沿用默认值）并删旧档；无档案不建空档案。
- 每张迁移单追加 `action: "rename_supplier"` 的采购变更，完整前后快照、序号按单连续递增。
- 有档案时旧名记删除（`after: null`）、新名记建立（`before: null`），`related_supplier` 互指；无档案不产生供应商历史；历史留原名、序号按名连续。
- 返回值就是 `supplier_record(target)`。

**`stock_room/__main__.py`** — ACTIONS 增加 `'rename-supplier': 'rename_supplier'`，自动沿用 JSON 输出、退出码 0/2 及数组逐项独立提交语义。

**`README.md`** — 新增 `rename-supplier` 完整条目，并在 purchase-changes、supplier-changes 两处动作清单（含文末汇总段）加入 `rename_supplier`。

## 验证要点

- 规格固定例：甲的 P1（PAPER 订 10、收 6 退 2）与已取消 P2 更名乙后重开目录，两单归乙、库存 4、P1 未收 4、P2 仍取消；旧名 `supplier-record` 抛错但历史可查，可重新建档/下单且序号接续。
- 改到已存在的丙：`ValueError`，`data.json` 字节、采购/供应商历史均无变化。
- 无档案来源：迁移采购单但不建空档案、不增供应商历史；历史专用名可做目标且新记录接续旧序号；旧档案缺字段按默认值、存储不补键；内部空白保留、区分大小写；CLI 成功/失败/数组部分成功/空目录行为均符合。
